analysis.session.observe
Evaluate named Metrics at an explicit output grain: overall, by time, by classification, or their combination.
Signature: session.observe(metrics: 'Mapping[str, Deferred]', *, during: 'TimeScope | CalendarAxis | None' = None, by: 'tuple[Deferred | MembershipAxis | MemberAxis | ComparisonAxis, ...] | Population' = (), where: 'Deferred | PopulationPredicate | None' = None, members: 'Population | None' = None)
Returns: AnalysisFrame
Input metrics: Pass a nonempty ordered mapping from output names to resolved Metric expressions; Artifact objects and IDs are rejected.
Input during: TimeScope filters without grouping; CalendarAxis adds time buckets and must match an existing output calendar; None adds no time filter.
Input by: Empty () computes overall Metrics within each time bucket, or one scalar without a CalendarAxis. Nonempty fields/membership descriptors add output axes. A Population or member() with members=P includes identities without facts; classifications must be single-valued on P.
Input where: Pass a Field predicate or closed PopulationPredicate; member_count requires single-valued conditions on the explicit members without reselecting them.
Input members: Pass one complete Entity identity Population from this Session or a literal identity domain; it restricts contributions independently of output grouping.
Constraint: Capture reads no source schema or business rows and creates no Run. Only compute/persist evaluate; persist publishes the completed result. Artifact objects and IDs are not Metric expressions. Value names are single nonempty segments without dots, backslashes, controls or reserved presence names.
Failure/repair: AnalysisError: inspect the structured identity, bound or recovery repair; no eager fallback.
Example inputs: session, metrics, calendar, field
Example:
result = session.observe(metrics, during=calendar, by=(field,))

analysis.session.observe
Evaluate named Metrics at an explicit output grain: overall, by time, by classification, or their combination.
Signature: session.observe(metrics: 'Mapping[str, Deferred]', *, during: 'TimeScope | CalendarAxis | None' = None, by: 'tuple[Deferred | MembershipAxis | MemberAxis | ComparisonAxis, ...] | Population' = (), where: 'Deferred | PopulationPredicate | None' = None, members: 'Population | None' = None)
Returns: AnalysisFrame
Input metrics: Pass a nonempty ordered mapping from output names to resolved Metric expressions; Artifact objects and IDs are rejected.
Input during: TimeScope filters without grouping; CalendarAxis adds time buckets and must match an existing output calendar; None adds no time filter.
Input by: Empty () computes overall Metrics within each time bucket, or one scalar without a CalendarAxis. Nonempty fields/membership descriptors add output axes. A Population or member() with members=P includes identities without facts; classifications must be single-valued on P.
Input where: Pass a Field predicate or closed PopulationPredicate; member_count requires single-valued conditions on the explicit members without reselecting them.
Input members: Pass one complete Entity identity Population from this Session or a literal identity domain; it restricts contributions independently of output grouping.
Constraint: Capture reads no source schema or business rows and creates no Run. Only compute/persist evaluate; persist publishes the completed result. Artifact objects and IDs are not Metric expressions. Value names are single nonempty segments without dots, backslashes, controls or reserved presence names.
Failure/repair: AnalysisError: inspect the structured identity, bound or recovery repair; no eager fallback.
Example inputs: session, metrics, calendar, field
Example:
result = session.observe(metrics, during=calendar, by=(field,))
